source: 2026-11-02 user-requested first-use guidance, including returning accounts after deleting and reinstalling the app; additive teaching overlay, not an original HTML screen
return_owner: Existing Home -> Auto Match entry -> Home stack; no extra route
eligibility: Authenticated, account verification and profile setup complete, and no completed/skipped guide receipt for this account in the current installation. The existing prepared fixture account follows its normal Home routing even without the local-registration onboarding_status field; explicit incomplete status and local registration gates remain enforced, with no seed/profile writes. Matching history is not proof that the guide was seen. Deleting the app and reinstalling clears its app preference; the next eligible login shows the guide again. Logout, refresh, process restart and an app update retain an existing receipt. A genuinely new owned matching session started during an unfinished guide interrupts that guide without writing a fake completion.

data.persistence: current installation's WKWebView app storage metadata through existing atomic Store transaction, isolated by account; not Keychain or cloud
data.default: missing means unseen; no startup write or account reset; no receipt added to seed or inferred from matching history

null; matching_ids snapshots only existing owned IDs on begin, remains unchanged across teaching steps, and is never a second copy of matching entities; page reconstruction, background or navigation never starts matching

technical_boundaries: Theme.json colors and existing MOTION values
Ready after existing 600ms Home skeleton; no extra navigation wait
Touch-first 44pt targets, no hover or click-through to real Join
Background/hide/unmount cancels pending writes and visual frames
No business arrays in pages, no direct storage in components
No new permission, automatic search, charge, fake match or fake chat
reinstall_boundaries: Delete App and reinstall is a fresh app-data installation; iOS Offload App with retained documents, backup restoration and ordinary app updates are not treated as data-clearing reinstalls
No existing user account, relationship, message, matching history or coin data is reset to trigger guidance
This rule does not introduce a remote account service or claim that an app-deleted user account can be recovered without an existing account source
Real user data must not be uninstalled or cleared for automated acceptance; use isolated test persistence or an explicitly disposable installation
